description: Zero-dependency Python library to check whether a file extension or path is binary, with a frozenset of 250+ known binary extensions. Python port of the binary-extensions npm package.
rules: Import from binary_extensions: is_binary_extension, is_binary_path, BINARY_EXTENSIONS, BINARY_EXTENSIONS_LOWER.
is_binary_extension accepts the extension with or without a leading dot and ignores case; it only checks the name, never file contents.
